newsitem.title: USA: HEI Q4 boosted by disk drive device.
newsitem.headline: HEI Q4 boosted by disk drive device.

text.p: HEI Inc said Tuesday its August 31 fourth quarter performance reflected the beginning of higher volume production of a previously announced device for use in high density disk drives.

"We are very pleased to see volumes on this program increase," said chief financial officer Jerald Mortenson in a statement. "As we gain experience, we are aggressively pursuing production efficiencies in anticipation of the significantly lower gross margin rate expected as full volume pricing is achieved."

Mortenson said, "We do not expect the fourth quarter's high gross margin rate to continue throughout fiscal 1997. At present, we anticipate reaching full volume production on this program sometime during the first or second quarter of fiscal 1997."

HEI, which designs and manufactures ultraminiature microelectronic devices, reported fourth quarter earnings of $1.3 million or $0.32 per share, which included a gain of $0.07 per share from a favorable deferred tax adjustment.
